stem: Which structure-function relationships are accurate? Select all that apply.
choices: Xylem conducts water and dissolved mineral nutrients through the plant
Phloem distributes sugars and other organic compounds among source and sink tissues
Stomata participate in carbon-dioxide entry and water-vapor loss
Internodes are the primary sites of root absorption
Glandular trichomes are specialized epidermal structures associated with metabolite production and storage
rationale: Xylem, phloem, stomata, and glandular trichomes have distinct transport, exchange, or secretory roles. Internodes are stem segments, not root-absorption structures.
